FFmpeg 7.1, Copyright (c) 2000-2024 the FFmpeg developers.
This app invokes FFmpeg as a separate process for local Matroska playback.

Binary distribution: imageio-ffmpeg 0.6.0 (pinned wheel SHA-256 in scripts/setup_media_runtime.sh).
https://pypi.org/project/imageio-ffmpeg/0.6.0/
Build recipes and distribution information:
https://github.com/imageio/imageio-ffmpeg/tree/v0.6.0
FFmpeg source for this version:
https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-7.1.tar.xz
https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/tree/n7.1

The included FFmpeg build enables GPL components and is licensed under GPL v3
or later. See COPYING.GPLv3. The imageio-ffmpeg wrapper license is supplied
separately as LICENSE; it does not replace FFmpeg's license.
